data.message: I propose 10 tons each this month: total catch 250, leaving 250, so stock returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. Repeating this yields $10,000 per person monthly without exhausting the lake. I intend to request 10 and encourage everyone to do the same. If stock is ever below 500, let's each request at most floor(stock/50), preserving at least half for recovery.
